{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]
", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None
", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, Optional[X] without a default is required (a v1 implicit default of None was removed). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior, so a missing key defaults to None. This also fixes test_blank_fields_become_none: profile_from_form drops blank/None values, so bio/website/age are now absent from the input and must default instead of raising 'Field required'. No other change is needed."}], "notes": "One edit covers lines 8-10 and resolves all three optional-no-default findings plus the test-failure finding (line 15), since the test failure is caused by the same missing defaults; profile_from_form itself needs no change. The `interests: List[str] = []` default is already explicit, and v2 copies mutable defaults per instance, so it is left alone. The `from typing import List, Optional` import is still used, so no import changes are needed."}
